remarks: Nestled in a peaceful Cul de sac in Stamford's sought after Westover neighborhood, this classic 4-bedroom Center Hall Colonial offers a rare opportunity to create your dream home on a beautifully landscaped one acre property. Surrounded by mature trees and lush plantings, the setting provides exceptional privacy and timeless curb appeal. Inside, generously sized rooms and a traditional layout offer the perfect canvas for renovation, expansion, or personalization. Two wood burning fireplaces keep you warm on cozy winter evenings. Whether you envision modern updates or preserving its classic charm, this home presents unlimited potential in one of Stamford's most desirable locations. 45 Carriage Drive S. has a back country feel, but is connected city water, sewer, and gas.  A two car garage protects your vehicles during winter storms. Convenient to downtown Stamford, parks, schools, and commuting routes, this is a unique opportunity to invest in both lifestyle and location.
